signal: DCI partnered with Hawthorn River on digital loan origination and with Array on credit tools, expanding its fintech footprint for community financial institutions

email.body1:
Gregory, saw DCI rolled out the Hawthorn River loan-origination integration and the Array partnership for community banks.

Adding fintech modules opens more cross-sell accounts than a regional team can realistically cover, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for DCI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Gregory, quick follow-up for DCI.

With new lending and credit modules to sell into the community-bank base, the number of accounts your region needs to touch just grew faster than you can add reps. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings that target now requires.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings your region needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.
email.body3:
Gregory, last bit of proof for DCI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire reps fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to peers selling into community FIs. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Gregory, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out new partner integrations is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to DCI either way.
